text: Jeyaaɓe e yimɓe buruure Madiina ɓen e takko ɗon on ari hino ngantinoo e Nulaaɗo Alla on (yo o his), fii yo o newnan ɓe tultugol e jihaadi ndin. Yimɓe goo kadi tulti, ɓen ɗon kan hay duŋinanooki yaltugol ngol; tawde ɓe gomɗinaa Annabiijo on e fodoore Alla nden. Aray ka lepte muusuɗe hawra e ɓen sabu keeferaaku maɓɓe ngun.
